text:
sam: quick thread to finalize owners for the KV OOM follow-ups. need clear checkpoints and a short mitigation playbook.
sam: i've sketched a minimal 'circuit-breaker' playbook in the ledger: https://redwood.internal/frag-ledger/ck-breaker
sam: goal is to reduce blast radius when shard-level KV growth spikes and avoid full-node OOMs.
evie: i'll own the canary for circuit-breaker flow + telemetry. plan: 3-node canary, enable soft-evict + route-to-spare for 72h. ETA 5 days.
jorge: i'll take the low-hanging GC tuning (gc_low, compact-on-idle) and the benchmark to measure fragmentation delta. ETA 4 days.
pm-ash: i'll own stakeholder comms and SLA implications. will sync with support on customer-facing notes.
infra-bot: incident: detected OOM wave on east-2 clusters at 2024-06-15T09:17:22Z -> 6 nodes impacted -> INC-5233 created
sam: adding INC-5233 to the ledger row. evie, can you correlate which shard got the soft-evict flaps before the OOM?
evie: initial trace shows repeated soft-evict events ~3-6 minutes before hard OOM on two nodes. attaching small extract:

evie: ```
[09:11:02] shard=shard-44 soft-evict start
[09:13:19] shard=shard-44 soft-evict end
[09:14:40] shard=shard-44 soft-evict start
[09:17:22] OOM node=rtx-21
```

jorge: interesting — soft-evict didn't trigger async compaction fast enough. my GC tuning will attempt more aggressive compact-on-idle and lower gc_low to 0.42 for canary.
jorge: baseline perf counters i'll capture:

jorge: ```
kv_alloc_rate: 9.8k/s
kv_free_rate: 2.1k/s
frag_ratio: 0.51
```

sam: evie, please also add a fallback that temporarily rejects new large writes when shard frag_ratio > 0.6 until compaction completes.
evie: yep that's in the circuit-breaker steps. behavior:
- if frag_ratio > 0.6 => set shard mode=degraded, throttle large writes by 70%
- kick async compact; if after 3 minutes frag_ratio not <0.55 escalate and route traffic away
- if free memory < 1GB => return 503 for new sessions

pm-ash: request: capture customer impact window and notify affected customers if mitigation causes 503s. coordinate with support.
sam: owners summary: evie=breaker canary+implementation+telemetry, jorge=GC tuning+benchmarks, pm-ash=customer comms. timeline: canary start in 5 days, 48h observation, decision at end of week.
jorge: i'll post flamegraphs and pprof output to the frag-bucket with tags canary-174600.
evie: will add dashboard panel for soft-evict counts, frag_ratio trends, and canary routing events. ETA 3 days.
infra-bot: note: recurring pattern hint: median time from first soft-evict to OOM = 6.8 minutes across historical incidents.
sam: last ask: please add 1-line weekly status in the ledger row before the decision meeting. i'll send calendar invite for the decision checkpoint once owners confirm. closing this thread after ledger rows updated. :white_check_mark:
